summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, reporting fiscal Q3 2026 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special-situations event. It highlights first-time segmentation after the June 1, 2026, acquisition of HoudiniSwap LLC, noting $1.2M in fees and $768K EBITDA from one month of operations. Staking income declined due to lower Solana prices and reduced block rewards. Assets under delegation were 3.4M SOL (~CAD$355M). No special-situation mechanics, terms, or advisors are disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic report, not a catalyst-driven filing, so it is categorized as 'None'.
